office_does: Hears and decides misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders in King County District Court for a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: sitting District Court Judge Brian Todd, appointed by the King County Council, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Sitting King County District Court judge appointed by the King County Council; previously an administrative law judge and an attorney representing clients in criminal, family law, and protection-order matters.
highlights: Lists occupation as King County District Court Judge and former Administrative Law Judge [S1]
Appointed by unanimous vote of the King County Council, per his statement [S1]
Prior practice included criminal defense, family law, protection orders, and mediation [S1]
